mintAuthority.summary: zkUSD is issued through Goal3's lockdrop portal on ZKsync Era. The token and minting portal are UUPS proxies owned by EOA 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d, with no permissionless mint route or upgrade delay.

controls.label: Goal3 owner EOA
controls.evidence: At zkSync Era block 71160345, owner() on both the zkUSD token and Goal3 portal returned 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d; eth_getCode on that address returned empty bytecode. The portal retained MINTER_ROLE on the token. Verified portal source calls returnToken.mint() in the lock path, and verified token source restricts mint() to MINTER_ROLE.

review.evidence: At zkSync Era block 71160345, zkUSD proxy implementation was 0xf0e28e2d31231e367d0dfe85da19a2dbc4ebb14b and Goal3 portal proxy implementation was 0xd3227d2b5c616dcf566ace0fec42507afef8e28d; both admin and beacon slots were zero. Both implementations returned the EIP-1822 implementation-slot UUID and verified source restricts _authorizeUpgrade() to onlyOwner. Both proxy owners were the same EOA, and the portal retained token MINTER_ROLE.
